research_result.description: Mailchimp provides a Marketing API to programmatically manage email campaigns, audiences, contacts, automations, e-commerce data, and analytics.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can obtain credentials by creating a free Mailchimp account, generating an API key in account settings, or registering an OAuth 2 application to obtain a client ID and secret.

evidence.claim: Mailchimp supports API key authentication for API access.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: You can authenticate requests using either your API key or an OAuth access token, depending on your use case.

evidence.claim: Mailchimp supports OAuth 2.0 authentication for accessing user data.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: OAuth 2 authentication provides developers with a secure way to access Mailchimp Marketing API data on behalf of other Mailchimp users.

evidence.claim: Mailchimp explicitly supports HTTP Basic Authentication for API requests.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: You can either use HTTP Basic Authentication or Bearer Authentication.

evidence.claim: Mailchimp explicitly supports Bearer Authentication for API requests.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: You can either use HTTP Basic Authentication or Bearer Authentication.

evidence.claim: Mailchimp provides a free self-serve account sign up path.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Create a free account or log in.

evidence.claim: The Marketing API follows REST conventions.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Marketing API generally follows REST conventions, with some deviations.

evidence.claim: A community-maintained Model Context Protocol (MCP) server is available for Mailchimp.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The most complete Mailchimp Marketing API MCP server: 227 tools across campaigns, audiences, reports, segments, automations and full e-commerce, with multi-account support and runtime-security guardrails (read-only, dry-run, audit, per-tool risk metadata).
